visual_base.visual_narrative_log: (1) A young woman with dark hair tied back stands on a city sidewalk. She wears a light pink button-up shirt and blue denim shorts, holding a white bag strap over her shoulder. She smiles brightly, winks, and gestures a peace sign toward the camera. Behind her is a large stone building with purple Berklee banners and a clear blue sky. (2) The scene cuts to the woman holding a silver flute horizontally to her lips. She wears white wired earbuds. Her fingers move rhythmically over the keys as she plays the instrument. A musical staff with notes appears as a semi-transparent overlay at the bottom. The background remains the same urban setting with greenery and stone architecture. (3) The performance ends, and she lowers the flute. She smiles warmly at the camera, waves her right hand, and turns her body slightly. The on-screen text 'Replay last summer!' appears in the lower center. The lighting remains consistent, bright natural daylight illuminating the street and the historical building exterior.
